description:
Managed code that applies the Java codec Function to the report data
        model: the ReportCodecManifest (the report records' ObjectDefinitions)
        plus the ReportCodecGen driver main. Invoked at build time by the
        output-only homing-conformance-report-codec module to emit the codec
        source. Kept separate so the model module (homing-conformance-rules)
        stays lean and the generated output stays quarantined.
